data.one_liner: Flutter heatmap calendar inspired by the GitHub contribution chart.
data.what_it_does: Provides traditional contribution chart widgets (`HeatMap`) and calendar-mode heatmaps (`HeatMapCalendar`) with customizable datasets, colorsets, and click callbacks.
use_when: You want to display a GitHub-style contribution heatmap in your Flutter app.
You need a calendar-based heatmap view to show data frequency over days and months.
avoid_when: You need complex line, bar, or pie charts instead of a calendar grid layout.
You require advanced statistical chart features not related to date-based intensity grids.
strengths: Includes both traditional contribution chart and calendar mode options.
Supports customizable color modes (opacity vs threshold color maps) and flexible sizing.
weaknesses: Limited to heatmap and contribution calendar visualizations.
Documentation for advanced layouts is sparse beyond README props and basic examples.
